technique_name: Compare the production costs of a digital product and a physical product with respect to the climate.
description: Digital products are often seen as more climate-friendly than physical products. Generally, the production of a digital product requires fewer resources, such as coal, water, and petroleum, than producing a physical product. Additionally, shipping a digital product requires no raw materials or packaging materials.
